data.one_liner: Lightweight framework with a JSON model generator, database operator, and web/WebSocket server/client.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive toolkit for building Dart servers and clients, including a JSON model generator, database operator interface for MongoDB, WebSocket/HTTP web framework, logging, and localization.
use_when: You want a unified Dart framework for both server-side and client-side web/WebSocket communication.
You are using MongoDB and want a strongly-typed database query builder combined with a code generator.
avoid_when: You need a backend framework supporting databases other than MongoDB (PostgreSQL support is only planned).
You are building a standard mobile application UI and only need isolated UI components.
strengths: Combines JSON serialization generation, database operators, and server/client networking into one library.
Strongly typed query builder helpers that reduce string-key errors.
Includes modules for localization, logging, and clustering support.
weaknesses: Database operations currently only support MongoDB directly.
Framework tightly couples multiple modules into a single package.
data.setup_notes: Requires running custom generator scripts (e.g. dart generator.dart) to generate data models and database auxiliary classes.
data.minimal_example:
// Example generator execution from README
dart generator.dart
